description: Plan Task 9: fixture sync check, documentation/steering/spec updates for the mandatory agent + Step Functions design, hook review, and final validation. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Fixtures: the real CLI regen needs valid AWS credentials (local ones are invalid, preflight exits 2). Instead reproduce with stubs: transform.run(offline=True, report_date=date(2026,11,14), ready_check=lambda *a, **k: 'stub', extractor=<stub raising if called>) and write_artifacts to a temp dir. Compare snapshot.bin bytes against frontend/public/snapshots/latest/snapshot.bin, schema/fixtures/snapshot.bin, rebellion-core/tests/fixtures/snapshot.bin (md5sum) and snapshot.json ignoring generated_at against both committed JSON copies. If identical apart from generated_at, leave committed fixtures untouched and record that. If they differ, copy the stub-generated files into all three fixture locations exactly as AGENTS.md describes and record the diff. Do not change the binary layout or schema.

Rewrite .kiro/steering/agent-enrichment.md: the agent is MANDATORY and the SOLE extractor (no heuristic); precedence curated overrides > agent; skip guard for fully curated rows; strict StrikeDossier contract (all required except nullable origin_country, attack_type from models.ATTACK_TYPES without 'unknown'); R6 country rule order and invalid codes -> DossierValidationError; R7 impact dedupe ('Impact not disclosed.', never on curated impact); preflight ensure_agent_ready (strands + pydantic import, sts.get_caller_identity, bedrock get_inference_profile / get_foundation_model) before any fetch, CLI exit 2; local CLI discards a failing article with no retries and exits 3 when >20% discarded; cloud Step Functions (Preflight -> Fetch -> Map(MaxConcurrency 5, Retry MaxAttempts 2 / IntervalSeconds 10 / BackoffRate 2, Catch -> discarded) -> Assemble -> Choice -> Fail when not published); DISCARD_THRESHOLD 0.20 keeps snapshots/latest and records Timeline status 'aborted'; model config (DEFAULT_MODEL_ID, --agent-model / AGENT_MODEL_ID, --agent-region / AGENT_REGION, no --use-agent / USE_AGENT); wiring list (sources, extract, transform, cli, stages, handler alias, template params PerFeedLimit/AgentModelId/AgentRegion, Bedrock IAM only on Preflight and Extract); testing rules (stub agent, stub boto3, never Bedrock or network). English only.

Update .kiro/steering/tech.md: stack table (add AWS Step Functions; Lambda stages; remove heuristic), Frankenstein seam paragraph (agent mandatory), data flow (sources filters + per-feed limit 25; agent extraction; geolocate only ISO -> coordinates), common commands (remove --use-agent; add --per-feed-limit; note credentials required even offline). Update .kiro/steering/structure.md only if it mentions the heuristic or handler (check).

Update AGENTS.md (it holds the former CLAUDE.md content; CLAUDE.md is deleted in the working tree by the user — do NOT recreate CLAUDE.md, record this): Extraction bullet, Platform/Update model (Step Functions, no SQS), target architecture Python bullet, Commands (credentials needed; --per-feed-limit), and the fixture regen note (requires credentials; stub-equivalent procedure).

Update README.md sections that mention --use-agent, heuristic extraction, or the single Lambda (lines ~53, ~97-107) to the new design. Edit only those passages; README has other pre-existing uncommitted user edits that must be preserved.

Update .kiro/specs/attack-globe/requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md: add requirements for R1-R11 in the file's existing style (EARS-style if used), update design data-flow/architecture (Step Functions, mandatory agent, discard threshold, no heuristic), and in tasks.md mark replaced items (e.g. heuristic extractor, handler.py monolith, --use-agent) as superseded and add a checked section for the tasks done here.

Hooks: .kiro/hooks/python-lint-on-save.kiro.hook already runs ruff/black/pytest on pipeline/**/*.py saves, so do not add a duplicate; update its prompt only if it mentions removed behavior. Update .kiro/hooks/regen-fixtures-on-curated-edit.kiro.hook: it references CLAUDE.md (now AGENTS.md) and should mention that the CLI needs valid AWS credentials/Bedrock access, and that curated rows missing required fields will call the agent and must be reviewed by the user. Update regen-snapshot.kiro.hook similarly if needed.

grep the repo (excluding .venv, node_modules, .git, .agents, report-ingestion-news.md) for use-agent, USE_AGENT, UseAgent, EnableAgent, heuristic, make_extractor, enrich( and fix any remaining stale references in docs/code. Never touch report-ingestion-news.md. Never add /.kiro to .gitignore.
Final validation: full pytest, ruff check, black --check.
acceptance_criteria: No stale references to --use-agent / USE_AGENT / UseAgent / EnableAgent outside .git/.venv/node_modules/.agents/report-ingestion-news.md

AGENTS.md line 1 still reads '# CLAUDE.md' / 'guidance to Claude Code' (user's file, header left as is). CLAUDE.md not recreated. Stale-reference grep: remaining hits for use-agent/USE_AGENT/UseAgent/EnableAgent/heuristic are only statements that they were removed, or tests asserting absence (test_pipeline.py:449, test_statemachine.py:108). Validation: pytest 173 passed; ruff and black clean; ASL JSON loads; hook JSON valid; .gitignore does not ignore .kiro. report-ingestion-news.md untouched: the orchestrator must ask the user whether to delete it or move it to docs/. Nothing committed. | Review v1 response (2026-11-14-172839-review.md): (1) Discard payload: FIXED. ASL Discard Pass now keeps only "error.$": "$.error.Error" (Cause stays in CloudWatch), so 125 failed items stay far below 256 KB; test_statemachine asserts it. (2) Substring filter: FIXED. sources._CYBER_KEYWORDS and _INCIDENT_SIGNALS are now word-boundary regexes (hack only as hack/hacks/hacked/hacker(s)/hacking), plus deny patterns for second-person explainers (^(what|how|why)...you/your), '^top N' listicles and 'to watch'; the review's examples are rejected, all 7 curated titles and the real-incident headlines still pass (new parametrized test). (3) No non-incident exit: FIXED. StrikeDossier gains required is_incident: bool; prompt explains it; _to_overrides raises new agent_extract.NotAnIncident (not a DossierValidationError) when false. transform.build_report skips it (not counted toward the threshold); stages.extract returns {key, status: 'skipped'} with no retry and no dossier; stages.assemble leaves skipped items out and records 'skipped' in the result and Timeline row. A curated row cannot be vetoed: extract_one converts the verdict to DossierValidationError (discard). Duck-typed dossiers without the attribute count as is_incident true. (4) Empty fetch: FIXED. transform.assemble raises ReportAborted(0, 0) when total == 0 (message 'no articles to report'), so the CLI exits 3 and Assemble keeps snapshots/latest and records 'aborted'; ASL Fail Cause updated. This also covers a run where every item was skipped. (5) Aborted rerun overwrites published row: FIXED. DynamoTimeline.record uses a conditional put for aborted rows (attribute_not_exists(#d) OR #s <> :published), swallowing only ConditionalCheckFailedException; published rows stay unconditional (a published rerun replaces latest too). InMemoryTimeline now mirrors the one-row-per-day semantics. (6) IAM: FIXED. Preflight gets only bedrock:GetInferenceProfile/GetFoundationModel; Extract gets only InvokeModel/InvokeModelWithResponseStream/Converse/ConverseStream; test asserts exact action sets. Not addressed (justified): JSONPath data-flow between states remains untested because it needs Step Functions Local or the TestState API (AWS), which the no-AWS test rule excludes; sam validate/cfn-lint still unavailable. Docs synced: agent-enrichment.md (invariant, contract table, threshold section, wiring IAM, testing), tech.md, specs requirements AC10 / design / tasks (new checked item), README, AGENTS.md.
